name: Octree Volume Ray Tracing
aliases: Interactive Isosurface Ray Tracing of Large Octree Volumes
Isosurface Ray Tracing of Octree Volume Data
Isosurface ray tracing of large octree volume data
Octree Volume Ray Tracing — Interactive Isosurface Ray Tracing of Large Octree Volumes, Octree Hashing
definition: A technique for interactive isosurface rendering of large compressed structured volumes by using a single octree structure that serves simultaneously as a lossless compression format for scalar data and an acceleration structure for ray traversal.
